name: ClaudeWave Trust Scores
description: Security and quality scores for repositories in the Claude AI ecosystem. Every record carries a deterministic heuristic score (maintenance, fork ratio, licence, owner history, README patterns). A subset also carries a deeper review of the repository tree, manifests and README, marked method=heuristic+review.

method.heuristic: Rules only, no model involved. Recomputed nightly against that day's catalogue. See scripts/trust-phase1.ts in the published methodology.
method.review: A model reviews the file tree, root manifests and full README, and every stated concern must quote the material it came from. Reviews that cannot be traced back to the evidence are rejected rather than published.
method.coverage: 54 of 4271 records carry a review (1.3%). The rest are heuristic only.

scale: 0-100, higher is safer. Below 40 a repository is hidden from the directory.
